note: Re-judged 2026-10-24 (independent auditor, authored none of the change). RFC 7911 Section 2: "However, the Path Identifier MUST be assigned in such a way that the BGP speaker is able to use the (Prefix, Path Identifier) to uniquely identify a path advertised to a neighbor." 071a80c5e5 and 690c96d6bf changed the cited producer session_write.go::writeUpdateBody: it records the AIGP recovery owed for a withheld route from the unfiltered withdrawal (noteAIGPWrite(body, true)) and passes false on the announce path. That bookkeeping reads the body and changes no path identifier, no adj-out ownership and no filter decision; the identifier producers in forward_path_id.go and session_ownership.go are byte-identical, so (Prefix, Path Identifier) uniqueness stays proven. Verdict unchanged: enforced. Earlier judgement follows. Rejudged 2026-10-23 by an independent auditor (not the author) after 010e649057, which makes the final writer (session_ownership.go adjOutWrite.allow) send a synthesized withdrawal only to a destination holding an adj-out record for the route. RFC 4271 Section 3.1 allows a withdrawal only for "the IP prefix that expresses the destination for a previously advertised route". RFC 7911 Section 2: "However, the Path Identifier MUST be assigned in such a way that the BGP speaker is able to use the (Prefix, Path Identifier) to uniquely identify a path advertised to a neighbor." The tagged carriers are byte-identical; what moved are two cited producers. session_ownership.go::allow: for a forwarded withdrawal of a key with no adj-out record it now returns false instead of owner.synthesized, so neither a received nor a synthesized withdrawal reaches a recipient that was never advertised the path; bindSourcePath still runs first and the refusal releases its binding as before. forward_provenance.go::prepareFwdProvenance: the per-path synthesized flag is removed and only the item-level synthesizedWithdrawal is kept. Neither change touches path-identifier minting, lookup, rewrite or release: generatePath, mintLocked, bindSourcePath, fwdPatchPathIDs and the writer patch are unchanged, and a withdrawal still carries the identifier the recipient was announced. The change removes the one case where a withdrawal could name a (prefix, Path Identifier) never advertised to that neighbor, which agrees with Section 5: "If a BGP speaker receives a message to withdraw a prefix with a Path Identifier not seen before, it SHOULD silently ignore it." Ran on 2026-10-23: all TestForwardPathID* units, including TestForwardPathIDWithdrawOfUnknownPathLeavesNothing and TestForwardPathIDWithdrawCarriesTheAnnouncedValue, PASS. Prior judgement stands: TestForwardPathIDsDifferForCollidingSources requires distinct outgoing identifiers for two ingress sources announcing the same native prefix under the same received identifier, and TestForwardPathIDStableAcrossUpdates requires the first source's exact prefix/identifier pair to stay stable after the collision and a repeat; the shared reader checks prefix, identifier, one complete NLRI and no trailing framing. The recipient-lifetime regressions in policy_replay_identity_test.go stay untagged complementary evidence.
